tool_args.rationale: Five observations show short-horizon positive gain, but do not establish the slow adaptation component or behavior near target H=24.9. The slow-horizon discriminating probe directly addresses this identifiability ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a dual-horizon endogenous adaptation model from the five short-horizon rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The large forecast horizon makes the slow component and reversal behavior insufficiently identifiable from short-window observations.
The key uncertainty is long-horizon reversal, so a targeted slow-horizon observation is more informative.
It is irrelevant to identifying the horizon-dependent law.
